headline: JSA advises Jindal Power on $1 billion financing for power project in Botswana
sum: Jindal Energy (Botswana) Proprietary Limited, part of the Jindal Power group, has availed $1 billion financing from a consortium of lenders comprising Axis Bank Limited, ICICI Bank Limited, and Export-Import Bank of India, for the…
detail: Jindal Energy (Botswana) Proprietary Limited, part of the Jindal Power group, has availed $1 billion financing from a consortium of lenders comprising Axis Bank Limited, ICICI Bank Limited, and Export-Import Bank of India, for the development of Phase I and Phase II of a greenfield thermal power plant in Botswana. As part of the financing, Jindal Power Ltd. has already signed an eight-year loan agreement of approximately $500 million with lenders. The remaining $500 million is expected to be raised in the coming months.
